chapter: Kid Rena, the Cadillac and Jones's sons
title: Kid Rena at the Cadillac and La Vida
summary: Kid Rena's band at the Cadillac, his sidemen, La Vida, and Sporter William Young.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands

blocks.x: Did you ever know Kid Renee? I worked with Kid Renee. Mm-hmm.
First time at the Cadillac. Mm-hmm. You ever heard of Cadillac? Sure. Down on St. Claude near the Industrial Canal. He had a drummer by the name of Brady. Brady Smith.
He did. Yeah, I know him.
Piano player was named Walter Daniel. He don't play anymore. You ever heard of him?
Heard of him. He's still around? Yeah.

He's a Almel clerk down at the Post Office. He don't play anymore. I work with Renny and I work with Renny. He was offing and on at the La Vida when he had his brother playing drums. Joe. Joe Renny. Paul was on the saxophone or either Lexus. You ever heard of a saxophone player named Alexis? I've heard of him but I never didn't know him. He was at the La Vida then. Then Renny came over to the fund on the Budweiser. He was over there with Sporter, William Young. Sporter. He was in the Bull. Yeah.
In the Bull. Who is William Young?
Is that Sporter? Yeah, that's Sporter. That's Sporter's name, William Young.
